decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Three year time limit
The development hereby permitted shall be completed within 3 years from the date of this permission.
Reason: To accord with the provisions of paragraph MA.2 (5) Part 3, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
Condition : 2 - Implementation (in accordance with approved plans)
The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: WR/90/01, WR/90/02, WR/90/03, WR/90/04, Internal Daylight Assessment, Planning statement. Received: 08/12/2025. 
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 3 - Restrictions on use
The hereby approved dwellinghouses are to remain in use as a dwellinghouse within the meaning of Class C3 of Schedule 1 to the Use Classes Order and for no other purpose, except to the extent that the other purpose is ancillary to the use as a dwellinghouse.
Reason: To accord with the provisions of paragraph MA.2 (6) Part 3, Schedule 2 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended).
Condition : 4 - Cycle parking to be provided
Secure covered cycle parking facilities (for not less than four bicycles) for the occupants of, and visitors to, the development shall be installed within the bicycle-store area shown on drawing no. WR/90/02, received 08/12/2025. The approved facilities shall conform to the current Westtrans West London Cycle Parking Guidance( or such other guidance as shall supersede it) in design and layout and be fully implemented and made available for use before the first occupation of the development or commencement of the approved use as appropriate and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction. 
Reason: In order to support sustainable transport objectives.
Condition : 5 - Highways and parking � parking permit restriction
Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the Local Planning Authority shall be informed of the agreed naming and numbering of the proposed dwellings so that arrangements can be put in place to ensure that, with the exception of a person eligible for a disabled person's badge issued pursuant to section 21 of the Chronically Sick and Disabled Persons Act 1970 (or similar legislation), no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit. Any occupiers of the approved development shall surrender any such permit wrongly issued or held. 
Reason: In order to protect the free flow and safety of traffic on nearby highways and to support sustainable transport objectives.
Condition : 6 - Domestic refuse specifications
Before the dwellings hereby approved are first occupied, the developer shall provide to each dwelling a set of containers required at the time of development for household use for the storage and collection of recyclable materials for the purposes of the Council's kerbside recycling service, to the specification then in use by the local authority's recycling collection service and shall notify the Council's refuse and recycling services when the development is first occupied.  The waste and recyclable materials containers shall be stored in a proprietary refuse bin enclosure designed for the purpose to be supplied by the developer and located adjacent to each dwelling. Each dwelling with a private garden shall also be supplied with a garden waste composting bin of at least 220 litres capacity at the same time. 
Reason: In order to protect the quality of the local environment and neighbours' living conditions and to endure appropriate means of refuse storage are provided
